It was just so weird. I cancelled my subscription like ten minutes after I subscribed. If this is the level of your writers, no wonder they hide out in this back room of an app.

reviews.title: Just about useless for me
reviews.text: I hate using the app. It’s fine for reading stories/articles but I manage several publications. I prefer to use the website because the app does not allow publication management and limited other functionality. However, if I try to manage the publications on the website, while also on a mobile device, it forces me to open the app where I cannot manage the publications. Beyond being worthless for my purposes, it is extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: Intrusive Ads
reviews.text:
I’ve been a Medium user for many years, and while the app hasn’t ever done much to hold my interest, it provided a comfortable and easy space to write.

In half a decade, I’ve never felt that my writing has ever been pushed by the algorithm. Most pieces don’t receive a single view. However, my real issue with Medium is a recent development.

Ads are now inserted directly into the middle of every piece of writing, even while reviewing those on my own profile. I understand the need for monetization, but for an app that already offers very little to users that don’t wish to pay, the presence of advertisements in the middle of writing is jarring enough to be a death sentence.

For an app that essentially already demands a paid subscription for basic features, I really hope the advertising placement is reconsidered.

reviews.title: Should Be An Option To Read For Free With Ads
reviews.text: Deleting the app after being blocked access from articles by a paywall. In this economy, many people can’t afford little luxuries. Having the option to watch ads to gain access would solve this issue for both parties. Poor design.

reviews.title: Corrupt/biased/
reviews.text: I would not recommend this to anyone. They manipulate the data so you can’t even be sure what is happening. They reset the stats and remove progress, engagement. If you don’t fit into their box of good enough, they don’t pay you. Even if people are reading your content. They will not communicate with you either. This website exploits their users. Nobody wins here unless you fit into their box. So if you think you’ll be up to their standards they may take advantage of you less. Seems to me the vast majority of peoples writing never gets seen and will never receive any kind of payment or feedback

reviews.title: Not Allowed to Disagree

reviews.title: Mediocre; not optimized for reading articles
reviews.text: For an app that is supposedly made for reading articles, it has at least two series problems that make me constantly delete the app then reinstall it s free weeks later only to find the same problems still not fixed. It does not have landscape resting mode! Unbelievable! And when I’m scrolling down in an article much too often it just switches to suns other random page instead with s list of other articles ! There is no “ back” button when this happens so I lose the sticker I was reading with absolutely no way to get it back as there is no reading history button either! I’ve scoured through all the settings endlessly it just does not exist and I an a tech savvy person (a web designer). Overall just not well thought out. Also there are oddly two different “account” buttons that will take you to completely different places, so no use memorizing what is held under the “ account” link it will drive you crazy. There seems to be very little logic behind the design of this app. It’s so bad I’m considering stopping my subscription and deleting my account as I don’t need extra stress in my life.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I downloaded this app at the hopes of learning new skills and acquiring more knowledge. Unfortunately I was greeted with articles written by delusional people who have a very limited understanding of the subjects they choose to write about. If you every disagree with an article don’t bother trying to explain your point of view. You’ll inevitably be blocked from commenting on the post and get emails every time someone wants to blatantly insult your perspective. Of course that person will not be blocked from commenting because they agree with the fragile ego that created the original article.  I really don’t understanding putting up a public article and doxxing everyone who disagrees.  Obviously what you believe is extremely frail if no one is allowed to have an alternative view point.

reviews.title: This app is no longer supported.
reviews.text:
Simple.

This app is no longer supported.  So I’m now limited entirely to accessing Medium via browser.  My primary use is with my iPod.  All other apps I frequently use are supported.

But not Medium.

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text: Really, the only good thing about the Medium app is its content. The app itself suffers from inconsistent scrolling, not remembering where you are on a page if you navigate out & back again, resetting all the scrolling content if it thinks you’re offline (this actually means its own api was unable to connect), bizarre behaviours such as the content you’re reading popping back to the list view if you accidentally perform a certain gesture (what gesture? Who knows). Surely it’s not too much to expect an app which is basically just scrolling text to get the basics right. Poor.
